top_left.description: A pile of tiny, pink, hairless babies huddling together in a nest of dry grass inside a hollow log; one parent is gently grooming them.

top_right.description: The mammal sitting on its haunches, holding a large Conifer seed in its front paws and nibbling quickly; cheeks are puffed out.

bottom_left.description: The mammal curled into a tight furry ball under a large Tree Fern leaf; only the tip of its pink nose is visible. Soft blue 'twilight' lighting.

bottom_right.description: Two small mammals play-fighting, rolling over each other in a 'fur-ball' on the 'Chalky white' silt; dust clouds are rendered as soft 3D puffs.

visual_logic.lighting: DAPPLED_EXCAVATION (High contrast to show off fur highlights).
